Black Friday ads

Rotating products (R01–R06): one ad whose products change every few seconds, one or two at a time, the gua sha always there; every product at one size everywhere, none overlapping, none cut. They are exported as video. Light versions (L01–L08): light cards on light backgrounds, the card at full size, larger products around it in three arrangements. New designs (N01–N10): richer light and finish, and six with your products spread around the card, larger, in every size. The first set (01–13) is kept to compare. Live previews; pick the numbers and they are exported at full size: post 1080×1350, square 1080×1080, story 1080×1920.
